title: Should Schools Start Later?
text:
Many students feel tired in the morning. Some schools start classes very early, at seven o'clock. Doctors say that teenagers need more sleep than adults. Because of this, some people think schools should start later.

Other people disagree. They say that parents need time to get to work, and buses must follow a fixed schedule. In my opinion, a later start is a good idea, because students who sleep well learn better and are happier at school.

questions.text: According to paragraph one, what time do some schools start classes?
According to paragraph two, what do parents need time for?
What is the writer's main attitude toward starting school later?
options: They are not sure about it.
They think it is too expensive.

questions.text: Why does the writer mention that teenagers need more sleep?
options: To prove that doctors are always right
To explain why a later start might help students
To show that adults need less sleep than children

young people between the ages of 13 and 19

paragraph_translations: Muitos estudantes se sentem cansados de manhã. Algumas escolas começam as aulas muito cedo, às sete horas. Os médicos dizem que os adolescentes precisam de mais sono do que os adultos. Por isso, algumas pessoas acham que as escolas deveriam começar mais tarde.

Outras pessoas discordam. Elas dizem que os pais precisam de tempo para chegar ao trabalho, e os ônibus devem seguir um horário fixo. Na minha opinião, começar mais tarde é uma boa ideia, porque os estudantes que dormem bem aprendem melhor e são mais felizes na escola.
